newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds slip after U.S. inflation data.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds slip after U.S. inflation data.

text.p: Argentine bonds were trading weaker late morning Tuesday in profit-taking following the release of U.S. consumer price data which confirmed a low inflation picture, dealers said.

But, with the market quiet ahead of an auction due Tuesday afternoon of Argentine Letes Treasury bills, which should provide a clear picture of investor sentiment, dealers said prices were likely to rebound soon.
"This profit taking could be a trampoline for a new round of buying," said one dealer.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was down 1/8 at 94-1/8 while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was down $0.38 at 117.65
